user.title: NeoPool MQTT Controller
user.description: Configure your NeoPool controller connected via Tasmota MQTT.

data_description.device_name: A friendly name for your pool controller (e.g., 'Pool', 'Zwembad').
data_description.mqtt_topic: The MQTT topic of your Tasmota device (e.g., 'SmartPool'). This must match the Topic setting in Tasmota.
data_description.berry_enabled: Enable only if the Berry script neopoolcmd.be is loaded on the ESP32. It provides the NPAux commands; the Aux switches are created only when this is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic is already configured.

data_description.berry_enabled: Enable if the Berry script neopoolcmd.be is loaded on the ESP32. Enabling creates the Aux switches and requests the Berry version; disabling removes the Aux switches. The integration reloads when you change this.
